note: Words and some prompts adapted from fridgemagnets by Luke Shafer (MIT license, see fridgemagnets-LICENSE.md). Other prompts and words are original.
prompts: Quit your job in the meanest way possible.
Tell your boss you'll be taking over as their boss.
Write a text to your mom telling her to stop calling you.
Tell your roommate about the exotic animal you've brought home as a pet.
Describe a prized possession that you're selling on Facebook.
Write a note to your upstairs neighbor who likes to stomp.
Tell your teacher you didn't do the assignment.
What's the number one cause of death?
Describe your most recent dream.
What is your favorite crime?
What is one rule you'd choose on the commune?
Pitch me your MLM.
Create a new trend on TikTok.
What are the youths up to today?
No more “Live Laugh Love.” Give me a new life motto.
Create a new reality TV show premise.
Write me a corporate jingle.
What would be the title of your autobiography?
What do cats do when we're not at home?
State a harmless controversial opinion.
Make the absolute worst sound you can think of.
Tell me a true story.
Leave a passive-aggressive note for whoever ate your leftovers.
Write a 1-star review of your own cooking.
Explain why you're late. Again.
Write the worst fortune cookie message ever.
Reply to the group chat you've ignored for a week.
Write a warning label for yourself.
Describe your cleaning routine. Be honest.
Write a terrible slogan for a dentist.
Complain to the manager about the weather.
Give the worst possible advice to a new driver.
Escape a conversation with a very chatty neighbor.
Explain to your landlord what happened to the wall.
Write your out-of-office email reply.
Tell someone what you really think of their kugel.
What does your pet say about you behind your back?
Announce your retirement from being an adult.
Give a toast at your nemesis's birthday party.
Invent a brand-new holiday. What are the traditions?
Pitch a truly terrible new ice cream flavor.
Write a breakup letter to your phone.
Apologize to your houseplants.
Explain the plot of your favorite movie, badly.
Give the least inspiring graduation speech ever.
Say the worst possible thing at a job interview.
Explain to the police why you were in the bushes.
Write a ransom note for a missing sock.
Tell us your villain origin story.
Write a yearbook quote you'll regret forever.
Convince us to join your very suspicious club.
File a complaint against the sun.
Ask your sibling for money without asking for money.
What's the last thing you want to hear from your dentist?
Write a horoscope that's way too specific.
What does the GPS say when you miss your exit for the fifth time?
Explain why you ate the whole cake.
Show off a secret talent nobody asked about.
Sell me this pen. Badly.
Describe yourself as a used car for sale.
Make a wedding toast for two people who can't stand each other.
Explain why you deserve a raise.
Give a museum tour of your messy closet.
Write a lullaby that would terrify a baby.
What's the worst thing to whisper in a library?
Post the rules of your kitchen.
What is the seagull thinking while it steals your fries?
Decline a party invitation as dramatically as possible.
Write the news headline about your day.
Give a motivational speech to a sloth.
Do sports commentary of yourself making breakfast.
Explain what really happened at the family reunion.
Write a one-star review of the Moon.
Text your boss at 2 a.m.
Describe a smell. Any smell.
Write the worst opening line for a novel.
Explain why the baby is wearing a tiny hat.
Confess something to your fridge.
Leave a review for your last nap.
What did the raccoon steal this time?
Write a thank-you note for a truly awful gift.
Describe your morning before coffee.
Name your band and its first hit song.
Write the instructions for a very sketchy piece of furniture.
Explain your browser history.
What are you whispering to the toaster?
Describe the drama at the HOA meeting.
Tell the waiter there's a problem with your soup.
What would your grandma say about this?
Write a dating profile for your vacuum cleaner.
Complain about your shoes to the shoes.
Write the speech you'd give if you won an award for napping.
